audit: Looks browser preset IDs versus executable LUT registry
scope: static source inventory; no inferred semantic mapping
mapping_contract: No browser preset is treated as mapped without an explicit implementation and an observed apply path.

existing_effect_availability.inspector_add_path: addSelectedEffectToCurrentTarget creates through ArtifactEffectService and adds to the selected layer or composition through ArtifactProjectService
existing_effect_availability.preset_property_ui: LUTEffect exports Preset as Integer without enum-option tooltip/metadata. The shared property editor has no hard-coded Preset enum mapping, so it falls through to the generic integer spinbox rather than a named preset chooser; LUTEffect::setPreset clamps input to indices 0..9.
existing_effect_availability.scope: Static source evidence for the general LUT effect path; not evidence that the separate Looks browser is connected or that image quality is accepted.

serialized_fields: properties including Preset, LUT File, Intensity
effect_preset_persistence.load_behavior: Applies the file to an already-created effect; rejects a non-empty mismatching effect_id and validates owned property payloads before mutation.
effect_preset_persistence.preset_round_trip_mechanism: Preset is serialized as an integer property and restored through LUTEffect::setPropertyValue -> setPreset, clamped to 0..9; Intensity is restored through setIntensity, clamped to 0..1 (non-finite becomes 1).
effect_preset_persistence.scope: Generic per-effect preset file support; does not create a named cinematic look library, connect the Looks browser, or prove project save/reload/runtime rendering.

integration_findings: The general Apply LUT effect is registered in InspectorEffectCatalog and ArtifactEffectService; ArtifactInspectorWidget::addSelectedEffectToCurrentTarget creates and adds it to a selected layer or composition stack. Its LUTEffect has nine built-in presets plus Custom. This is static source evidence, not a runtime click-through.
The Preset property is currently a generic integer field, not a named chooser. The code-level built-in enum exists, but Inspector property metadata does not expose those labels.
No LooksPresetBrowserDialog construction callsite was found under Artifact/src or Artifact/include.
Dialog Apply updates only appliedId_ and a badge; it does not create or apply an effect, notify a caller, or close the dialog.
No browser preset ID to LUTEffect preset mapping was found in the inspected source.

Generic effect-preset JSON includes the LUT effect id and its Preset / LUT File / Intensity properties, and can apply them to an existing LUTEffect. This is a file API contract from source inspection, not an executed save/load round trip.

Composition-level LUT persistence differs from layer-level persistence: composition JSON writes the LUT properties, but its local deserializer does not instantiate LUTEffect and falls back to the base ArtifactAbstractEffect. Layer deserialization uses ArtifactEffectService::createEffect and can rebuild the concrete LUTEffect. See findings.json RD0-COMPOSITION-LUT-RESTORE-01; static source path only, runtime round-trip pending.

GPU final-post-process distinction (static callsite audit): ArtifactFinalPostProcess::updateFromEffectStack returns after finding an enabled LUT entry and documents that the caller must separately call updateFromColorLUT with actual LUT data. Repository search of Artifact/src and Artifact/include found no updateFromEffectStack callsite; updateFromColorLUT is called by ArtifactIRenderer viewportDisplayPostProcess_ with viewport display LUT data. This does not prove GPU application of the composition/layer Apply LUT effect. Pinned source hashes for the post-process implementation, interface, and renderer are in sources; runtime/backend behavior remains unverified.

Reusable named-enum editor path (static source audit): ArtifactPropertyEditorShared::enumOptionsForProperty accepts Integer properties and parses AbstractProperty metadata tooltip entries formatted as comma-separated integer=label pairs, then the property editor routes the property to ArtifactEnumPropertyEditor. LUTEffect::getProperties currently returns Preset as Integer without this option tooltip; the editor therefore receives no enum options for Preset. A future named chooser can reuse this existing metadata path by supplying the complete 0..9 mapping; this conclusion is source-only and has not been exercised in the UI.
